entries.title: Haunting Ground

emulation.emulator: PCSX2; Sony PS2 Classics emulator on PS3 for the Japanese digital release
emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 with an owned PS2 copy for the primary route. The Japanese PS3 PS2 Classics version is an official but region-constrained route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 assets and presentation with emulator-side resolution and filtering improvements.

primary.why: Haunting Ground is primarily a PS2 release; the Japan-only PS3 PS2 Classics version is an official access route, but the PS2 version through PCSX2 is the best practical fidelity route for a full English playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PS2 copy on original hardware or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for cleaner capture. The Japanese PS3 PS2 Classics release is an alternate official route if available.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release; PCSX2 can improve capture resolution from an owned copy.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete English-capable original release and strongest practical fidelity route through PS2 emulation.

all_releases.fidelity: Japan-only PS2 Classics release for PS3.
all_releases.reason: skip: official access route, but region/language constrained and no fidelity advantage over PCSX2 from an owned PS2 copy.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No exclusive content split was identified; the PS3 version is a Japan-only PS2 Classics rerelease.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS3 release is a PS2 Classics rerelease, not a remaster or remake.
